segments.name: Electric
segments.description: Regulated local distribution of electricity to residential and commercial & industrial customers in New Hampshire and Massachusetts.
segments.evidence: Unitil's electric distribution operations are conducted through two of the Company's utilities, Unitil Energy and Fitchburg.

segments.name: Natural Gas
segments.description: Regulated natural gas distribution and interstate gas transmission pipeline operations serving customers in New Hampshire, Massachusetts and Maine.
segments.evidence: Unitil's natural gas operations include gas distribution utility operations and interstate gas transmission pipeline operations.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Non-utility operations including centralized services, real estate and short-term investments, reported after intercompany eliminations.
segments.evidence: The results of these non-utility operations are principally derived from income earned on short-term investments and real property owned for Unitil's and its subsidiaries' use and are reported, after intercompany eliminations, in Other segment income.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated rates for electricity and natural gas distribution service, with supply costs recovered on a pass-through basis under regulated reconciling rate mechanisms.
revenueModel.evidence: Both Unitil Energy and Fitchburg supply electricity to those customers who do not obtain their supply from third-party competitive suppliers, with the approved costs associated with electricity supply being recovered on a pass-through basis under regulated reconciling rate mechanisms that are periodically adjusted.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Bangor Natural Gas Company, expanding its natural gas service territory in central Maine.
changes.evidence: On January 31, 2025, the Company acquired all issued and outstanding shares of Bangor for $71.4 million, which includes an estimated working capital adjustment.
